immortal_time_bias.mechanism: A regime cannot reach an observation where drawdown_from_peak >= 0.15 without first surviving the non-zero time interval from T_PEAK to T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM. Any regime that suffered an immediate terminal flip directly from peak hazard contributes rows only to the still-elevated pool and zero rows to the recovered pool.

retrospective_conditioning.mechanism: In the parent study, observations with drawdown >= 0.15 were evaluated against the overall regime outcome (OPPOSITE_FLIP_BEFORE_NEW_MAX) rather than evaluating forward price opportunity exclusively from the confirmation timestamp forward.

observation_level_overweighting.mechanism: Long, lingering regimes generated dozens of repeated observations with drawdown >= 0.15, whereas quickly resolving regimes generated fewer rows, overweighting persistent survivor trajectories.

corrective_action.action: Re-estimate recovery outcomes using strictly causal prospective recovery-confirmation event timestamps (T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM).
corrective_action.prospective_event_definition: For each regime, identify T_PEAK (first timestamp reaching acute stress threshold) and T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM (first subsequent timestamp where running_peak - current_hazard >= 0.15). Only outcomes occurring after T_RECOVERY_CONFIRM are evaluated.
